reason: My sales already run on Chariow and the delivery is automatic there. Here I'd have to watch SasPay and confirm every sale by hand on WhatsApp, and on a busy evening that is more work for me, not less, even with 0% commission.
objection: I don't know who is behind Maketia, and I don't want to move my customers onto a new platform that could disappear in six months. On top of that, no automatic confirmation means I'm doing the delivery myself.
would_change_my_mind: Automatic payment confirmation with SasPay, plus a well-known creator in my niche showing their real sales on Maketia.
